extreme.question: In a high-stakes scenario involving Vancomycin levels (item 25), findings align with this mechanism: Excessive exposure raises nephrotoxicity risk; dosing is individualized. Which choice is the single best interpretation or action concept?
options: A) Routine trough targets of 40–50 mg/L for simple cellulitis
B) Serious MRSA infections use AUC-guided or historically higher trough targets with nephrotoxicity vigilance
C) Giving flumazenil to every undifferentiated overdose without caution
D) Treating hypoglycemia with IV insulin as first-line care
extreme.answer: B) Serious MRSA infections use AUC-guided or historically higher trough targets with nephrotoxicity vigilance
extreme.explanation: Excessive exposure raises nephrotoxicity risk; dosing is individualized.
